biography: Stefan Verhoeven, a name whispered with increasing frequency in Belgian motorsport circles, hails from the unassuming town of Sint-Truiden. His journey began not on the asphalt, but on the muddy trails of cyclocross, a sport where he honed his bike handling skills and developed an uncanny ability to read changing surfaces. Stefan's transition to racing was almost accidental; a friend dared him to enter a local karting event, and he won, handily. That victory ignited a fire. He poured his savings into a used kart, practicing relentlessly on weekends. His raw talent earned him a spot in a regional racing series, where he impressed with his consistency and calm demeanor under pressure. Currently, he is making a name for himself driving the Ultima GTR. While he hasn't yet secured a major championship, his steady progress and unflappable attitude suggest a bright future.
drivingStyle: Verhoeven is a driver defined by precision and calculated risk. He isn't one for flamboyant overtaking maneuvers or daring late-braking dives. Instead, he meticulously studies track conditions, identifying the optimal line and conserving his tires. His corner entry is smooth, almost gentle, but his exit speed is deceptively quick. He excels at managing pressure, rarely making mistakes even when under intense attack. His approach could be described as 'slow is smooth, smooth is fast', and it has proven remarkably effective.

rivalries.name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
rivalries.reason: A clash of styles; Dubois, known for his aggressive, 'all-or-nothing' approach, often criticizes Verhoeven's 'conservative' driving.

rivalries.name: Annelies De Vries
rivalries.reason: A fierce on-track battle in a recent race resulted in a controversial collision, sparking heated words and lingering animosity.

rivalries.name: Ricardo Mancini
rivalries.reason: Mancini, a veteran driver, sees Verhoeven as an upstart threatening his position, leading to a series of petty incidents both on and off the track.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky socks, knitted by his grandmother, for every race.
Listens to classical music, specifically Beethoven, to calm his nerves before a race.
Meticulously cleans his helmet visor with a specific brand of microfiber cloth before each session.
famousQuote: Pressure is a privilege. It means you're in the fight.
careerHighlight: Winning the Spa-Francorchamps Challenge Cup in 2022, a race he entered as a massive underdog, showcasing his skills in treacherous wet conditions.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the Zolder Grand Prix in 2023 due to a mechanical failure, costing him a potential breakthrough victory.
